Response shape of ``/items/news/summary/``: a bare
``{tags, summary, updated_at}`` object (not a paginated list).

The action serializes through this class so the OpenAPI schema is derived
from the real response. ``updated_at`` is emitted as the raw ISO 8601 string
the action produces, so it is a ``CharField`` (not ``DateTimeField``) to keep
the wire format byte-identical.
